harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured snapshot-backed XFS storage at /srv/data, proved rollback from deliberate modifications to the exact earlier content, retained a known_good snapshot, and verified persistence through a node restart. RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Installed the RHEL-supported LVM2 package without upgrading the OS or kernel.
Created a persistent LVM thin pool and XFS logical volume mounted at /srv/data.
Captured application data in the pre_change snapshot.
Deliberately modified files, permissions, and a symlink, and added/deleted files.
Merged pre_change into the origin and verified an exact manifest match.
Created and retained the known_good snapshot.
Restarted node1 and verified the changed boot identity, active storage service, mounted filesystem, snapshot availability, and intact data.

evidence.summary: /srv/data is an XFS logical volume; pre_change was created from data, and known_good remains as a retained thin snapshot.

evidence.requirement: Modify the directory and restore the exact earlier snapshot content
evidence.summary: The baseline manifest hash was 7dc5b9c885a92778aaaca391a2ed5e94fa1276b7cb013a570a4bf75def376e7c. Mutation produced a different hash; snapshot merge restored the original hash and cmp confirmed an exact match.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Before and after the work, node1 reports RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64.

Captured healthy baseline with boot ID 3aee314b-4dfc-4c3a-90f6-2b07c621eaa0, received restart acknowledgement, observed new boot ID 8aed7d32-1b4f-478f-8ee3-dafe290d18c3, and proved full recovery: system running, storage service active, /srv/data mounted, known_good present, and data exactly matching the baseline manifest.

attempts.summary: Configured snapshot-backed XFS storage at /srv/data, proved rollback from deliberate modifications to the exact earlier content, retained a known_good snapshot, and verified persistence through a node restart. RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64 remain unchanged.
